title: ... chưa? — Asking if something is done yet

segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: How much?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu?] [EN: I want coffee.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn cà phê.] [EN: Is there water?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Có nước không?] [EN: Are you hungry, to a man?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh có đói không?] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Phải không?] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Right?] [EN: Good.]

[EN: To ask if something is done yet, end with] [VI: chưa] [EN: The verb to eat is] [VI_F: Ăn.] [EN: flat tone.] [EN: Say eat.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ăn.] [EN: Now ask, have you eaten yet?] [VI_F: Anh ăn chưa?] [EN: Note this vowel — relax your lips, do not round them. Ask it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ăn chưa?] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Two answers. If done, say already.] [VI_F: Rồi.] [EN: Say already.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rồi.] [EN: If not, repeat the word] [VI: chưa] [EN: which alone means not yet.] [VI_F: Chưa.] [EN: Say not yet.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chưa.] [EN: Good. So the question and its two answers are: have you eaten? — already, or not yet.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ăn chưa? Rồi. Chưa.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Have you eaten yet?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ăn chưa?] [EN: Answer, already.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rồi.] [EN: Answer, not yet.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chưa.] [EN: Try the frame with another verb. Have you gone yet?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh đi chưa?] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Rồi.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Already.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chưa.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Not yet.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen. A friend greets you the Vietnamese way.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Anh ăn chưa?] [VI_M: Dạ, rồi. Còn chị?] [VI_F: Em chưa.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Ask, have you eaten yet?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ăn chưa?] [EN: Answer, already.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Rồi.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you customize an order. The preview word is] [VI: thêm] [EN: which means more.]
